item.description:
A new Aldi opened Thursday at 8867 Southeast Bridge Road in Hobe Sound, offering Martin County shoppers an affordable option as grocery prices continue to strain family budgets. The USDA expects grocery prices to rise 2.8% this year, with fruits and vegetables seeing an increase of less than 1%.

item.title: Port St. Lucie ranked 67th most stressed city in United States
item.description: Port St. Lucie was tabbed as the 42nd most financially stressed city in America, according to a WalletHub study released this month that compared 182 cities across 39 metrics.

item.description:

item.title: Women's Professional Baseball League unveils team names and logos ahead of August debut
item.description: The Women's Professional Baseball League announced the nicknames and logos of its four teams, each inspired by pioneering women, as the league prepares for its inaugural season starting August 1.

item.title: Lionel Messi leads Argentina to dramatic 3-2 comeback victory over Egypt in World Cup round of 16
item.description: Argentina scored three goals in the final 11 minutes of regulation time to rally from a 2-0 deficit and defeat Egypt 3-2, with Lionel Messi scoring his eighth goal of the tournament.

item.title: US-Belgium World Cup match draws record 30 million viewers, becomes most-watched soccer telecast in American history
item.description: Monday's United States-Belgium World Cup match drew more than 30 million viewers on Fox Sports, peaking at 36 million early in the second half despite the US losing 4-1.

item.title: Justin Bieber, Madonna, and BTS to headline World Cup final halftime show at New York on July 19
item.description: FIFA announced Wednesday that Justin Bieber will join Madonna, Shakira, and BTS for an 11-minute halftime performance during the World Cup final, supporting a $100 million education fund.

item.title: Karolina Muchova defeats Coco Gauff in dramatic Wimbledon semifinal tiebreaker to reach final
item.description: Ninth-ranked Karolina Muchova ended seventh-ranked Coco Gauff's Wimbledon run Thursday with a 6-2, 1-6, 7-6 (10) victory, becoming the fourth Czech woman to reach the final in six years.

item.description: Florida's updated Live Local Act took effect today, expanding affordable housing opportunities across the state.

item.title: Fort Pierce art teacher shot and killed; family member arrested
item.description: Andre Leonard Barnes, a 66-year-old art teacher, was shot and killed Tuesday afternoon near the 2700 block of Essex Drive in Fort Pierce.

item.title: Neighbors push back on proposed 85-acre Indrio Town Center development
item.description: A proposed 85-acre development off Indrio Road and Russakis Road in St. Lucie County is moving closer to reality, but neighbors say it will transform the area's rural character.
